observations: All three acceptance lines assigned to the tester pass at head 6cb177065b18aaacf06078dcfe1e4bfcc1ca26d1, which equals the head the architect expected; GitHub reports MERGEABLE / CLEAN.

The Legion smoke-rig daemon (pid 2064804 per /tmp/legion-83-smoke/daemon.pid, http://127.0.0.1:19483) stopped between 18:41:34Z (last daemon.log line, a normal resync) and 18:43Z: no /proc/2064804, connection refused on 19483, no crash line in daemon.log. Until the controller restarted it (new pid 3353218, listening again at 18:51Z) every credentialed command (`legion gh`, `jj git push`, `legion handoff complete`) and the pane's bash tool itself failed with 'Unable to connect', because the extension mints the grant from the daemon before each bash command. All GitHub evidence above was gathered before the outage; `legion handoff write` (local) ran during it; the E2E edit, the handoff push and `legion handoff complete` ran after it.

This handoff is committed and pushed per the LEGSMOKE-188 architect's direction; the tested head 6cb177065b18aaacf06078dcfe1e4bfcc1ca26d1 and the new head carrying test.json are both named in the completion summary.
The working copy @ carries the daemon-provisioned empty .omp/config.yml; it is not in any pushed commit (head tree listing above shows no .omp path).
Tool notes confirmed: bare `gh` on the pane PATH is not the Legion shim, and the pane's builtin `cmp` cannot read a process substitution; `legion gh --` and `/usr/bin/cmp` were used throughout.
